The '''Moorsh Moraine''' was one of the many glacial features located on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Its location was east of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] and adjacent to [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]]. It was here that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] landed prior to the start of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The incorrect spelling "morraine" is also used in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''.
